professionalTitle: Embedded AI & ML Verification Engineer for Space Systems
tagline: I design and verify dependable embedded AI systems for space applications, transforming machine-learning models into traceable, testable and operationally constrained engineering components.
summary: Embedded software and ML verification engineer focused on dependable AI for space systems. Experienced in C++, Python, Docker and embedded Linux, with hands-on portfolio work covering dataset assurance, Operational Design Domain definition, ML robustness testing, neural-network fault injection, deterministic safety cages and runtime monitoring. I build traceable engineering workflows connecting requirements, tests, evidence, residual risks and deployment decisions.

contact.availability: Open to technical collaborations in Embedded AI, ML verification and aerospace software (configure in profile).
